description: The host reports the hold notice failed, and the pickup timer is cancelled before it fires.
source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="notifying">
    <state id="notifying">
        <onentry>
            <send type="library:notice" target="patron" event="hold.ready" id="notice"/>
            <send type="library:timer" target="hold_queue" event="pickup.expired" id="pickup" delay="10ms"/>
        </onentry>
        <transition event="error.communication" target="notice_failed"/>
    </state>
    <state id="notice_failed">
        <onentry>
            <cancel sendid="pickup"/>
        </onentry>
    </state>
</scxml>
